_comment: Local stdio only. Token comes from the environment, never inline. For CSD 509J the API URL is https://csd509j.instructure.com/api/v1. ENABLE_DATA_ANONYMIZATION=true replaces student identity fields with Student_xxxxxxxx before results reach Claude.
claude_code_cli: claude mcp add canvas-api --scope user -e CANVAS_API_TOKEN="${CANVAS_API_TOKEN}" -e CANVAS_API_URL="${CANVAS_API_URL}" -e ENABLE_DATA_ANONYMIZATION=true -e CANVAS_ROLE=educator -- uvx --from canvas-mcp canvas-mcp-server
claude_desktop_alt: Or download canvas-mcp.mcpb from https://github.com/vishalsachdev/canvas-mcp/releases/latest and double-click it.
skills_install: npx skills add vishalsachdev/canvas-mcp  (or copy ./skills/* into ~/.claude/skills/)
